local_prerequisites.QA_TARGET_SHA: 40-character served source_revision matching local runtime health
local_prerequisites.runtime: PGlite/mock local_test persistent health, supported profile routes, real signed checkout completion control
local_prerequisites.execution: No replacement runtime, missing readiness must fail before mutations. Metadata and list-only selection are not application acceptance.
local_prerequisites.operator: P16 uses runtime-owned GET /api/local-runtime/operator, requires303/admin/sellers and issued real BetterAuth session roleoperator before fixtures; no credentials or QA DB promotion.
local_prerequisites.QA_LOCAL_EVENTS_PATH: Runtime-owner supplied bound route under /api/local-runtime/ for reviewed signed-event handlers; POST/GET require real buyer order/run ownership. Source handler existence alone is insufficient.
local_prerequisites.current_tour: Reviewed eb2be3a product proof/finish contract plus persistent catalog and original runtime checkout.simulation.complete signed-payment binding; no client claimed completion.
local_prerequisites.signed_http: Runtime owner launches --webhook-fixture 1 to select the repository public fake fixture secret behind local guards; QA_WEBHOOK_SECRET_KNOWN=1 alone does not change signing.
